Subject: Exploring embedded brokerage & marketplace listing for Catalyst Analytics

Hi Olga,

I'm Beth on Partnerships at Catalyst Analytics — thanks for taking a look. We're evaluating two paths to bring Redwood into our product: (1) a marketplace listing (AWS & GCP) with co-sell enablement, and (2) an embedded brokerage model where we surface Redwood inference behind our SaaS paywall and reconcile usage through a reseller/managed offer.

High-level asks:
- What evidence you need for marketplace certification (metering, billing, security checklist)
- Typical SKU/pricing patterns for embedded brokerage (resale vs private offer)
- A sample timeline for a joint pilot (30–60 days) and required handoffs

I've attached a short brief that summarizes our hosting footprint and compliance posture. Our initial preference is AWS (we run most production there) but GCP is in scope for our enterprise customers.

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute call this week with the alliances and commercial teams? I can include our procurement lead Trey Morgan if we get into contract/procurement questions.

Thanks — looking forward to exploring this.

Best,
Beth Carter
Head of Partnerships | Catalyst Analytics

Hi Beth — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the brief — helpful context. I'm the alliances contact for marketplace and embedded reseller paths. Happy to run the call and map out a mutual action plan.

Quick answers up-front:
- Marketplace evidence: standard meter/billing contract examples, SOC2 report (or MSA equivalency), customer telemetry sample (token per request shapes), and a lightweight integration test plan for metering accuracy.
- Embedded brokerage: most partners pick either a private-offer resale (managed SKUs) or a sell-with bundle depending on commercial goals. We provide SKU map templates and a simple billing shim for reconciliation.
- Timeline: for a limited pilot with one cloud region + private offer, we typically see a 4–8 week loop (evidence + pilot + pricing delta) if legal is responsive.

Can we confirm:
1) target cloud(s) (you mentioned AWS/GCP)
2) objective for the pilot (co-sell enablement vs. embedded resale revenue)
3) any hard constraints from your procurement (max lead time, required NDAs)

I've attached our one-pager on marketplace onboarding; Ben (alliances ops) and Vivek (commercial) are on copy to own SKU/pricing and co-sell commitments. Karthik will help with technical evidence mapping.

Proposed agenda for the first call (30 min):
- Intros + objectives (5m)
- Marketplace vs embedded brokerage tradeoffs (10m)
- Evidence and SKU mapping asks / owners (10m)
- Next steps and timeline (5m)

What times work for you Thursday or Friday?

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference

Looping in the ops checklist and a proposed SKU map for an embedded-resale pilot.

Quick mutual action plan (MAP) suggestion:
- Week 0: Intro call, confirm cloud & pilot objective (Olga / Beth)
- Week 1: Evidence collection (Catalyst provides SOC2 or equivalent, telemetry sample, landing page flow) — owner: Catalyst (Trey) / Karthik to validate integration plan
- Week 2: Redwood prepares proposed SKU map and pricing bands (attached: proposed_sku_map.pdf) — owner: Ben
- Week 3: Technical smoke-test of metering shim + billing reconciliation (Karthik + Catalyst eng)
- Week 4: Pilot go-live (limited users) and co-sell enablement playbook prep (Vivek to own co-sell entitlements)

Attachments included: proposed_sku_map.pdf (SKU suggestions + mapping notes), catalyst_evidence_matrix.xlsx (evidence checklist keyed to AWS/GCP listing gates).

Risks / open questions:
- If Catalyst needs reseller margin > 25% we need a pricing sync; Vivek, please flag acceptable thresholds.
- Metering fidelity: need a sample of request/response shapes so Karthik can sign off on the adapter.

I'll draft the HubSpot deal and add the MAP — HubSpot id linked here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765. Legal may want an NDA before detailed billing numbers; Beth, if you can drop Trey on the thread we can expedite.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
